title: Eyef's Exploration
description: An exploration modpack that keeps you exploring.
body:
# Eyef's Exploration

## A modpack aimed to enhance exploration and encourage you to explore.


This modpack incorparates over 300 of unique biomes, spanning across all 3 dimensions, along with adding 15000+ new blocks to overhaul your world with. It also contains hundreds of new mobs and structures to insentivise you to explore the vast realms in your new world.


The official modpack of Misty Mountain SMP
